rule: real state of every declared path, computed by resident-runtime/intr_path_transfer.py verify over the organization ledger at ledger_tip; no path receipt exists yet, so every path is FAIL_CLOSED. Path receipts appear only once the transfer declaration lands on main and .github/workflows/organization-ledger-writer.yml appends them; the destination half stays FAIL_CLOSED until the destination's ledger records the path ingress.
verified_transfer_note: a main merge whose main-merge transfer receipt the tests append to a temporary ledger copy (temp_merge_transfers); this organization's ledger has no main-merge transfer receipt yet
unledgered_note: a main merge with no main-merge transfer receipt at ledger_tip and none appended in the tests
temp_merge_transfers_note: main merges whose main-merge transfer receipts the tests and the PR dry-run append to their temporary ledger copies first (for an organization whose ledger has no main-merge transfer receipt yet); those receipts are NOT LEDGERED and NOT AUTHENTIC
